winterizing.label: Winterizing
winterizing.note: Full winterizing programme - engine, water circuits, batteries, covers.

insurance_survey.label: Insurance survey
insurance_survey.note: Interval set by your insurance contract.

gas_installation.label: Gas installation check
gas_installation.note: To be carried out by a qualified professional, per local regulations.

antifouling.label: Haul-out and antifouling
antifouling.note: Interval depends on your sailing programme and the antifouling used.

thru_hulls.label: Thru-hulls and seacocks
thru_hulls.note: Check at every haul-out: operation, corrosion, hose clamps.

saildrive_boot.label: Saildrive boot
saildrive_boot.note: Most manufacturers recommend replacement every 7 years.

oil_change.label: Engine oil change
oil_change.note: Whichever comes first - refer to the manufacturer's manual.

fuel_filter_diesel.label: Fuel filter and water separator
fuel_filter_diesel.note: Drain the water separator far more often than you replace the filter.

impeller.label: Raw water pump impeller
impeller.note: Replace immediately after any overheating or dry running.

anodes.label: Engine anodes
anodes.note: Inspect far more often than the replacement interval.

injectors.label: Injector check
injectors.note: Workshop operation - the interval varies widely between engine makers.

valve_clearance.label: Valve clearance adjustment
valve_clearance.note: Refer to the manufacturer's manual: some engines never require it.

exhaust_elbow.label: Exhaust elbow
exhaust_elbow.note: A classic corrosion point on marine diesels: inspect well before the interval.

winterizing.label: Engine winterizing
winterizing.note: Flushing, antifreeze, internal protection - follow the manufacturer's procedure.

traction_battery_check.label: Traction battery pack check
traction_battery_check.note: Have the diagnosis done by the manufacturer or an approved installer.

loft_inspection.label: Sail loft inspection
loft_inspection.note: Washing, seam and reinforcement check, repairs where needed.

standing_rigging_check.label: Standing rigging inspection
standing_rigging_check.note: Visual check of terminals, chainplates and turnbuckles.

standing_rigging_replacement.label: Standing rigging replacement
standing_rigging_replacement.note: Commonly recommended at 10 years - some insurers require it sooner.

mast_unstepping.label: Unstepping and full mast inspection
mast_unstepping.note: Often combined with standing rigging replacement.

service_battery_bank.label: Service battery bank replacement
service_battery_bank.note: Service life depends heavily on the technology and the cycling.

shore_power.label: Shore power inlet and RCD
shore_power.note: Test the residual current device at the start of every season.

bilge_pumps.label: Bilge pumps and float switches
bilge_pumps.note: Test the automatic trigger, not just the manual override.

watermaker.label: Watermaker service
watermaker.note: Flush and pickle per the manual, especially before a long lay-up.

liferaft_service.label: Liferaft service
liferaft_service.note: Interval set by the liferaft manufacturer - often 1 to 3 years.

fire_extinguishers.label: Fire extinguisher check
fire_extinguishers.note: Annual check, with periodic pressure testing depending on the type.

flares.label: Distress flare replacement
flares.note: Flares carry an expiry date - use it as the due date.

lifejackets.label: Lifejackets and inflators
lifejackets.note: Check the cylinder, the inflator head and the bladder's air tightness.

epirb_battery.label: EPIRB battery
epirb_battery.note: The replacement date is printed on the beacon.

winches.label: Winch strip-down and greasing
winches.note: One winch stripped per year is enough on a lightly used boat.

steering_system.label: Steering system, cables and ram
steering_system.note: Check play and lubrication before each season.

trailer_service.label: Trailer service
trailer_service.note: Bearings, lights, brakes and straps - check before every tow.
